tools.name: get_afgift_rates
tools.description: Machine-readable Danish vehicle registration tax rates 2026–2029: skalaknæk (brackets), CO2 tiers, bundfradrag and EV/plug-in phase-in (indfasning) percentages per year. Identical to GET https://bildata.io/api/afgift-prognose/rates. 2027–2029 rates are provisional.
